title: Fur Friends ⚔️ Battle Edition Day 22 | The Potion Shop | Cozy Kawaii RPG Animation & Lofi
description:
POP! Pink smoke rolls out of a potion shop. Inside is Pom the Alchemist, a hamster in goggles. Pom joins the party, an Elixir Bomb calms the Bubbly Slime King, and everyone tries silly potions at the tasting party.

0:00 Pink Smoke in Town
0:45 Pom the Alchemist
1:30 The Bubbly Slime King
2:15 Potion Tasting Party

⚔️ Fur Friends: Battle Edition — the Fur Friends are adventuring in Pawlandia Online, a cozy fantasy MMORPG world. A new friend joins every episode!
🐾 No one gets hurt: bonked monsters just get dizzy, then become friends.
🎧 Best with headphones. Original lofi music & cozy fantasy sounds.
